name: Celmira Thammasak-Johansson
role: Field trauma surgeon and combat support — combat medic
location: The Underbelly — sub-street tunnels and maintenance corridors, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description:
Luca Thammasak-Johansson is broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 35, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains) — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — he has the city in his blood, its rhythms in his bones, its cruelty in his expectations. He works as a combat medic out of The Underbelly, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Luca Thammasak-Johansson operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
core_desires: To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "Hold still. This is going to hurt and I don't care."
"I can keep you alive through almost anything. What I can't do is make you grateful."
"Blood type? No, I don't need your blood type. I need you to stop moving."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Eshe Pena-Baah once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
The fixer who handles Eshe Pena-Baah's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
A dead drop Eshe Pena-Baah maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: As a combat medic, Eshe Pena-Baah embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains). Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture

physical_description.heritage: Indigenous American-dominant mixed ancestry (49.8%) with significant Southeast Asian (23.7%), South Asian (14.0%), and Hispanic/Latin American (12.5%) heritage. Features reflect this complex blend — the broad Indigenous American bone structure, prominent cheekbones, and medium warm base tone are enriched and deepened by Southeast Asian and South Asian phenotypes, with Latin American warmth adding golden undertones. His appearance reads as genuinely cosmopolitan, a product of the Ubiquitous Diaspora, without clear categorical origin.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavily muscled through the chest and arms, with a solid core that speaks to decades of physical labor and field medicine. Carries weight with deliberate control — not fat, but density. The kind of frame that fills doorways.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, graying at the temples and through the beard
physical_description.hair_style: Worn close-cropped on the sides, slightly longer on top. Beard kept trim but deliberately rough — maintenance rather than grooming. Practical, not aesthetic.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm tan with golden and olive undertones. Southeast Asian and South Asian components deepen and enrich the Indigenous American base, while Latin American heritage adds warmth and amber notes that catch light. Sun-weathered with subtle golden undertones visible in direct light. The complexion speaks to mixed ancestry and years of field exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined — 35 years in the GLMZ shows in the face. Deep crow's feet from squinting in bad light and years of focus. Facial structure shows prominent Indigenous American cheekbones, refined by Southeast Asian and South Asian features that soften the angles slightly. Broad nasal bridge with the characteristic width of Southeast Asian phenotypes. A scar runs through his left eyebrow. His expression defaults to neutral assessment, the micro-expressions of someone who has learned to read people for survival.
distinguishing_marks: Visible scar tissue at the base of his skull where a cortical bomb was surgically removed — a raised, keloid-textured line about 3cm long, slightly discolored
Thin white scar running through his left eyebrow and down to his cheekbone, roughly 2 inches, from bladed trauma
Burn scars on his right forearm — old accidents with cautery equipment — mottled and pale against his warm tan skin
Tattooed surgical grid on his left inner forearm: coordinates and medical reference marks in fine black ink, practical rather than decorative
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome shows. Neural interface jack at the base of the skull — visible as a dark metallic port surrounded by the keloid scar tissue from removal of the cortical bomb. Both hands show chrome knuckle reinforcements barely visible under skin tension. His right eye has faint LED reflectivity in certain light angles — subcutaneous neural interface telemetry.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with the economy of someone who has learned every motion costs. No wasted gestures. When still, his weight settles into his hips and legs — stable, grounded. When moving through tight spaces (his native environment), he flows with practiced ease despite his size. Hands are steady and deliberate. His default expression is neutral observation, but his eyes never stop tracking.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical — worn synthleather field coat in charcoal over reinforced mesh cargo pants with multiple pockets for medical supplies and tools. Steel-toed work boots, scuffed but maintained. Under the coat: a military-grade trauma harness in black, visible when he moves. No logos, no chrome fashion, no corporate branding. Everything is functional and worn. The clothes have seen things. A surgical mask hangs around his neck, ever-ready. Carries a modified medical kit on his hip like a sidearm.
